title: Long-Term Investment Returns of Temasek Holdings and GIC
what_it_is: Long-Term Investment Returns of Temasek Holdings and GIC

sections.label: Temasek and GIC returns
sections.summary: Temasek's Net Portfolio Value rose from $164 billion in 2007 to $275 billion in 2017, and Temasek and GIC delivered long-term returns.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: For example, Temasek’s Net Portfolio Value was $164 billion in 2007, compared to $275 billion in 2017.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: Temasek’s investments delivered an annualised nominal shareholder return of 6%, in Singapore dollar terms, for the 20 years ended 31 March 2017.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: Similarly, over the same period, GIC achieved an annualised real return of 3.7%; this is over and above inflation.

sections.label: FY2018 NIRC estimate
sections.summary: In FY2018, the NIRC is estimated at about $15.85 billion, or about 18% of overall revenues.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: In FY2018, the NIRC is estimated to be about $15.85 billion, or about 18% of overall revenues.

sections.label: NIRC and GST question
sections.summary: GIC and Temasek have made money long term, so GST need not rise due to investment losses, as NIRC keeps taxes low.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: In the case of GIC and Temasek, their long-term performance has been very creditable, as I had explained earlier, and they have made money over the long term.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: Hence, to the question of whether we have to raise GST because of investment losses on certain counters, that is plainly not the case.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: The NIRC is the single largest source of income of Government revenues, and it has enabled us to keep taxes low, and also to keep GST increases at bay for many years.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: If we did not have the NIRC, then we would have had to either double the amount of personal income tax or our GST collection to fund the same amount of expenditure over the years.

sections.label: Planned GST increase
sections.summary: The GST increase is planned ahead of time to keep Singapore in a sound fiscal position for increased social and security expenditure.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: The GST increase is planned for ahead of time to ensure that we are in a sound fiscal and financial position to meet the increased expenditure on the social and security needs of Singaporeans in the years to come.
